correctness.rationale: For n>=2, every q and output X of rank r, AB=0 implies im B<=ker A so ranks a+b<=n; ARB=X also forces im X<=im A and ker B<=ker X, with a,b>=r. Images of A, kernels of A, kernels of B, images of B are independently chosen under these constraints: [n-r a-r]_q [n-r b-r]_q [n a]_q [n-a b]_q. Operators with each fixed image/kernel pair counted by GL_a(q) GL_b(q), and R↦ARB is onto the ab-dimensional compatible linear subspace, all fibers size q^(n²-ab). Summing gives rank-only w_{n,r}, with zero for 2r>n and nonzero via a=b=r otherwise. Independent exhaustive n2 q2 and q3 all outputs matches formula including zero and rank one: q2 zero712, rank1 24; q3 zero19953, rank1 432.
